headline: Skyworks posts a director role to found a Central AMS Verification team
fact: Skyworks posted a Director, Central AMS Verification role to found and lead a central AMS SoC verification team. The mandate includes an enterprise-wide UVM/RNM/AMS platform, common model and verification-IP libraries, coverage, assertions, convergence, and automation. AI/ML-assisted harness and model generation, root-cause analysis, and agentic flows are listed as capabilities the role is expected to build.

sources.title: Director, Central AMS Verification
sources.summary: Official Skyworks role posted July 6, 2026, with a mandate to found a central team and build common AMS verification infrastructure.
